title: Project-scoped Model Parameters Create Request
description: POST /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/model-parameters. The backend reads modelId (optional; a placeholder model is created if absent). Modeled on the backend create request (extra=allow / unknown=EXCLUDE → additionalProperties:true; the backend generates the id server-side). The backend reads `model_id` (must name an existing catalogue model, else 422) and the numeric parameters below; `modelId` is the legacy spelling and is ignored by the route. `model_id` is not marked required so the request schema does not narrow. The properties added beside `modelId` carry a description only, no type or bounds: this request was open and must keep accepting every earlier body.
